newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd sees more price pressure in 97.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd sees more price pressure in 97.

text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Thursday it was too early to give a profit forecast for full-year 1997, and that it saw ongoing price pressure.
"For 1997 we are taking into account continued pressure on tariffs. It is therefore too early in the year to give a firm forecast on the results of P&O Nedlloyd," Nedlloyd said.
"It is our conviction that Nedlloyd is far better equipped to face the future after the merger (with P&O)...The merger advantages will become clearer during the course of the year," it said.
